name: pragmatic-skills
description: Curated skills for Claude Code, with parallel Codex prompts where applicable.

plugins.name: pragmatic
plugins.description: Bundle of all pragmatic-skills. Install once to get everything, including mobile autoship.

plugins.name: muchotexto
plugins.description: Answer in the minimum sentences that carry the meaning. Start at one and proactively grow by +1 only when a fact, caveat, or step would otherwise be lost.

plugins.name: review-fix-loop
plugins.description: Address external review findings through a watcher -> implementer -> verifier loop with model-pinned subagents. Implementers never commit; an independent verifier attacks the merged result by execution before anything ships.

plugins.name: loopcopy
plugins.description: Package the work you are doing right now into one self-contained /loop command and copy it to the clipboard, ready to paste into a fresh session on any OS.

plugins.name: vault-session
plugins.description: Persistent session memory for Claude Code backed by an Obsidian vault exposed through an MCP filesystem server. Provides /resume and /save with first-run bootstrap that registers the vault MCP on each new machine.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Mobile auto-shipper. Drive a chat request through analyze -> implement -> QA -> PR on a real simulator/emulator/device. The orchestrating agent is the coder — no separate engine CLI. Includes backend/Supabase and Flutter QA setup.

plugins.name: backend-comprehensive-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent end-to-end backend/API PR review: phased orchestrator with parallel review passes, real-request runtime verification against a project-configured non-prod target, and a PR-ready verdict. Auto-configures a per-repo review extension.
